text: {"lessons":["My account value fell despite several months with no trades, so holding through market swings still carries risk; I should judge progress over a longer horizon, not one month at a time.","Buying more of several stocks did not prevent losses, so I should set sensible position limits and keep enough cash rather than assuming diversification alone makes the portfolio safe.","I should decide in advance what would justify buying or selling each holding, and stick to that plan instead of reacting to recent price moves or gains, while keeping my ten-year apartment goal in view."]}
